title: Water Main
body: Assume a $$20**\circ$$ C temperature: the density of water is $$1000\,\tfrac{\text{kg}}{\text{m}**3}$$ and its viscosity is $$1.005\times10**{-3}\,\text{Pa}\cdot\text{s}$$. $$Take$$ $$the$$ $$onset$$ $$of$$ $$turbulence$$ $$to$$ $$be$$ $$at$$ $$a$$ $$Reynolds$$ $$number$$ $$of$$ $$2000$$.
